Econometrics, causal ML, reinforcement learning, mechanism design and foundation models.

::: {.hero-subtitle}
This site is a structured programme for developing research-level competence in modern data science and computer science while retaining economics as the organising discipline.
:::

## What the programme is designed to achieve

By the end of the core programme, the target workflow is:

$$
\text{read a frontier paper}
\rightarrow
\text{understand the mathematics}
\rightarrow
\text{reproduce it}
\rightarrow
\text{modify the method}
\rightarrow
\text{design a research contribution}.
$$

## Core sequence

1. Research-level Python and computing
2. Statistical learning
3. Modern causal ML
4. Deep learning fundamentals
5. Optimisation, algorithms and complexity
6. Bandits and reinforcement learning
7. Algorithmic game theory and computational mechanism design
8. Multi-agent reinforcement learning and learning in games
9. Foundation models for structured and relational data
10. Research specialisation

[View the full roadmap →](roadmap.qmd)

## Working principle

Each module follows the same progression:

**Learn → Implement → Replicate → Extend → Research**
